jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de back-end
jobs_results.description:
En SEREM estamos comprometidos con diversos proyectos y queremos contar con los mejores profesionales del sector. Nos encontramos en búsqueda activa de un/a Desarrollador Backend para trabajar en importante compañía internacional ubicada en Málaga.

Functions:

Develop and maintain applications for German retailer Group.

Design, implementation, quality assurance and documentation of the code

Code responsible from the very beginning until production environment

Participation in the design of software architectures and the selection of technologies.

Work closely together with a German product team (English mandatory)

Technical Requirements:

Experienced in Java 8+ development and related frameworks such as Spring Boot.

Practical experiences in software development and working in a development team.

Good testing practices (Unit testing, Junit, Mockito, automated testing).

Experienced practices in some Database development (SQL, Hibernate, Hadoop, Db2, HBase). Good problem-solving... skills and starving to keep learning and touching new languages/frameworks

You live in Spain, and you have a valid permit work /VISA.

Verbal and written advance knowledge of the English language.

Desired requirements

Kotlin and Linux shell experience.

Experience with Apache Kafka, Kubernetes and/or GCP.

Experience using Big Data tools such as Yarn and Apache Drill.

Knowledge of German language.

What we offer:

• A startup-like culture with fascinating opportunities, combined with the security of being part of a major corporate force in the Group.

• Challenging tasks but also a tech playground.

• Work in a modern office, fostering creativity, collaboration, and agility.

• A flexible, autonomous work environment where your ideas will contribute to our collective success.

• Open communication culture in an international environment with steady growth, and more to come!

Our Benefits

• Hybrid work (at least once a month on site) and flexible working time

• Private health insurance

• Ticket Restaurant

• Professional development opportunities: English/German courses, and further IT education/trainings

• 23 days paid vacation

Fomentamos un ambiente de trabajo multicultural e inclusivo, no discriminamos por edad, género o creencias; así como ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades a todo el personal.

Desarrollamos nuestras actividades bajo los principios del cuidado del medioambiente, la sostenibilidad y la responsabilidad social corporativa; colaborando en proyectos de reforestación y sostenibilidad.

Apoyamos los 10 principios del Pacto Mundial y los 17 Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible, en materia de derechos humanos, condiciones laborales, medio ambiente y anticorrupción.

Los procesos de reclutamiento se desarrollan bajo altos estándares de calidad definiendo la incorporación en base a la experiencia y habilidades del candidato.

Somos una empresa española líder en servicios tecnológicos y atracción del talento presente en el mercado desde 1995. Contamos con más de 600 empleados en proyectos tanto nacionales como internacionales en sector TI

jobs_results.title: Backend Engineer
jobs_results.description:
(€35k-€40k per annum)

Our team in Spain is currently seeking a Backend Developer to join our dynamic team. We are looking for talented, self-motivated individuals with strong expertise in AWS and a passion for data.

Who We Are?

First let us introduce ourselves, we are FERO and are a VC backed startup building a brand new solution that improves the customer experience when completing checkout and payment journey driving an increase in conversion and increased revenue for our clients.

The Role & Your Responsibilities
• Technical Excellence: FERO values innovation and quality, and as a Back End Engineer, your role is at the heart of our mission, focusing on high-performance, scalable, and testable code within our architecture.
• Design and Develop: Collaborate with an exceptional team to craft scalable products, focusing on performance, scalability, quality, and testability. You will be at the forefront of innovation, engaging in our RESTful API initiatives, and preparing for... exciting future developments.
• Performance and Scalability: Utilise cutting-edge technologies to boost system performance and tackle scalability challenges.
• Quality and Testability: Uphold the integrity of our codebase through comprehensive test-driven development and continuous integration frameworks.
• Innovation: Stay at the leading edge of technology, with a readiness for potential explorations like SDK development and language migration.

What You Must Bring?
• At least 3 years of experience as a Backend Developer, with hands-on expertise in AWS services and infrastructure.
• Strong proficiency with Python. Experience with Django is a big plus.
• Familiarity with both relational and non-relational databases such as PostgreSQL and DynamoDB.
• Extensive experience designing and working with REST APIs.
• A DevOps mentality, with a willingness to bridge development and operations.
• Working Permit in Spain

Desirable Traits
• Curiosity, resilience, positivity and a passion for continuous learning and growth.
• Resourcefulness, inquisitiveness, and a supportive attitude towards colleagues.
• Team collaboration, exemplary communication skills, and a drive to solve complex problems.
• Start up mentality

Why Work at FERO?

As an early-stage, VC-backed startup, FERO provides competitive pay combined with employee equity (we are all owners!). We have an exquisite/central office for our Tech hub in Madrid and have a very creative and collaborative culture. We offer:
• Unique greenfield environment to drive change in a global business. What we are doing is brand new which offers exciting challenges to overcome
• Joining at this stage in our journey will open up opportunities for exponential growth in professional and personal development
• Friendly and supportive colleagues
• Hybrid working model: 3 Days office/2 Days WFH
• Competitive compensation package and private health insurance that is half sponsored by FERO

Where to From Here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. First steps are for you to forward an english CV to this advert

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Estamos en busca de un Desarrollador Backend entusiasta y altamente habilidoso para unirse a nuestra agencia de marketing digital innovadora y de ritmo rápido. Como miembro clave de nuestro equipo de desarrollo, trabajarás estrechamente con nuestros desarrolladores para diseñar, desarrollar y mantener sistemas backend que potencien los sitios y aplicaciones de nuestros clientes.

El candidato ideal tiene un entendimiento sólido de los conceptos de desarrollo backend, incluyendo APIs RESTful, diseño de bases de datos y programación del lado del servidor utilizando lenguajes de programación y frameworks relevantes. Estamos buscando a alguien que disfrute colaborando con un equipo de desarrolladores frontend y backend, que quiera sumergirse en algo de código y diseñar sitios innovadores y revolucionarios.

.....

We are seeking an enthusiastic and highly skilled Backend Developer to join our fast-paced and innovative digital marketing agency. As a key member of our dev team, you will... work closely with our developer team to design, develop, and maintain backend systems that power the sites and applications of our clients.

The ideal candidate has an understanding of backend development concepts, including RESTful APIs, database design, and server-side programming using relevant programming languages and frameworks. We are looking for someone who enjoys collaborating with a team of frontend and backend developers, wants to get their hands dirty in some code, and design cool ground-breaking sites.

What You'll Do
• Collaborate closely with the Director of Technology and Backend Lead to address technical challenges across diverse projects, spanning analysis, timeline management, execution, and deployment of various technologies.
• Implement efficient data storage solutions and optimize database performance.
• Write clean, modular, and maintainable code following best practices and coding standards.
• Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, consistency, and adherence to coding standards.
• Troubleshoot and debug issues, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to ensure smooth operation of backend systems.
• Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends, and propose innovative solutions to improve system architecture and performance.
• Collaborate with frontend developers to integrate frontend components with backend services.
• Contribute to the design and architecture of new features and enhancements.

Who You Are
• At least one year of experience in backend development or a similar role and/or a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Proficient in diverse programming languages, including PHP and JavaScript, along with prominent JavaScript frameworks like React.js, Vue, and Astro.
• Strong understanding of backend development concepts, including RESTful APIs, database design, and server-side programming.
• Familiarity with relational and non-relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
• Basic understanding of web development technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Solid problem-solving skills and ability to debug and troubleshoot complex issues.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to writing clean, efficient code.
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and quickly learn new technologies and tools.

Perks and Benefits
• 15 observed holidays + 23 PTO days per year
• Indefinite contract following a trial period of 6 months
• Permanent remote work + work from home stipend
• Dedicated budget for professional development
• Compensated onsite retreats at our Bilbao HQ
• The opportunity to join a dynamic, close-knit team that loves going to work with and for each other every day

About Terra

Terra is a digital marketing and creative agency built by an integrated and international team of content creators, strategists, designers, and developers. We help organizations reimagine and deliver their most ambitious digital projects and initiatives by acting as an extension of our clients’ teams and delivering exceptional online experiences, content, and marketing strategies.

Our team is innovative, tech-forward, and creative by nature. We are dedicated to pushing boundaries and staying ahead of the curve in today’s ever-evolving digital landscape. We believe in the power of collaboration and foster a work environment that encourages creativity and growth. And with a strong focus on work-life balance, we prioritize the well-being and career development of our team members. Finally, we are committed to promoting from within and offering meaningful opportunities for professional growth.

Terra is also an equal opportunity employer.

We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote team members regardless of their race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status (as required by applicable law).

Our top goal as an employer is to bring together a diverse mix of talented people who are excited to join our company, stay with Terra for a long time, and do their best work while they’re here. We take pride in the quality of the services and work we provide to our clients, and we know none of it is possible without the hard work and commitment of our passionate and creative employees

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Who we are 🚀Architecting a new Identity for the Internet

Gataca is a cybersecurity company that provides self-sovereign identity technology. We power users with a mobile ID wallet to enjoy passwordless, hyper-secure and privacy preserving access to digital services worldwide. Read more about what we do at gataca.io

Since its inception at MIT in 2018, Gataca has received several European grants, has deployed impactful projects with organizations like the European Commission or the Royal Mint of Spain (FNMT), and has been featured by prominent publications such as MIT, Forbes, Business Insider, and Expansion.

If you want to join a growing startup with an ambitious goal, keep reading!

What will you do? 💻

Gataca's goal was (and still is) to have a (positive) impact on society, and for that we decided to improve the current authentication mechanisms on the internet (and in the physical world).

For this, during the years of life of the company, we have helped in the definition of... the standards that today are being used for the specification of the European Wallet, and we have implemented a solution following these standards so that anyone in Europe (and the world) can benefit from this technology.

Currently, we have a productive solution where many clients from all Europe are configuring and verifying their users, changing the authentication paradigm in Internet.

To remain at the forefront of technology, we want to increase our technical team with a profile that has at least 3 years of experience in backend technologies. We’re looking for a self-driven individual that embodies the spirit of overachievement, dedication, and teamwork and that can take Gataca to the next level. Main responsibilities include:
• Work closely alongside a cross-functional engineering team to develop backend technology, writing server-side code, developing rapid prototypes, evolving current products, and creating robust production applications
• Develop products from scratch, determining the structure & architecture of our backend end applications
• Develop features to improve the platform security.
• Participate in code reviews for others' work.
• Troubleshoots and corrects backend-end application-related issues.
• Optimize services for maximum performance and scalability
• Build reusable code for future use and shared among the backend end applications.
• Develop and maintain technical & support documentation

Who do we need? 🏄Skills
• Mid to Backend Developer, with a proven track record of 3+ years in Backend development, ideally with experience in Golang coding.
• You enjoy solving complex technical problems. Can’t stop until you find a solution.
• You are comfortable working with abstract problem statements and enjoy giving them shape to find tangible solutions
• You are comfortable adapting to fast-paced markets with changing needs
• You like working in small teams
• You are resourceful and proactive
• You prefer to work in a company where there is so much to do yet, than in a company that offers a very-well defined job
• You know how to balance quality and results: you strive for maximum quality, but know when to stop and deliver.
• You are comfortable with deadlines
• You are persistent and keep a positive attitude in adversity
Attitude
• You are self-driven – you are determined to achieve goals, without needing to be encouraged by anyone else
• You are a team player - you love to work with people
• You are adaptable – you can easily adapt to environmental changes

Requirement
• Authorization to work in Spain (Europe)

What do we offer? 👇
• Gross salary: Depending on profile
• Contract type: full-time
• Highly innovative and motivating project
• Career development opportunities
• Startup mindset: fast-paced, friendly, fun work environment, which a focus on productivity, collaboration, and innovation
• Work-life balance: combination of Work from home + office that adapts to your needs
• Flexible schedule
• 23 working days per year of vacation + Birthdays off

When, where? 🌍

We enjoy our own office in Madrid, very close to M-30 at the Metro station, Av. de la Paz.

During Covid, we’ve prioritized remote work as a first option and some team members are enjoying it, so we’ll keep a balance moving forward. We like to meet at least once a week, but flexibility and work-life balance remain a priority.

Schedule: Mon to Fri., flexible

• Work-life balance: combination of Work from home + office that adapts to your needs
• Flexible schedule
• 23 working days per year of vacation + Birthdays off

When, where? 🌍

We enjoy our own office in Madrid, very close to M-30 at the Metro station, Av. de la Paz.

During Covid, we’ve prioritized remote work as a first option and some team members are enjoying it, so we’ll keep a balance moving forward. We like to meet at least once a week, but flexibility and work-life balance remain a priority.

Schedule: Mon to Fri., flexible

jobs_results.company_name: LIS Data Solutions ES | Data for Change
jobs_results.description:
Hola, somos LIS Data Solutions, una ingeniería especializada en el análisis de datos, que acompaña y ayuda a las empresas a transformar y desarrollar su negocio con soluciones tecnológicas en proyectos de Industria 4.0, Analítica avanzada de Datos, Big data e Inteligencia Artificial.

En LIS tenemos desarrollada una cultura que sitúa a las personas en el centro, y por ello en 2022 hemos sido premiados por la Calidad en el Empleo en Cantabria.

Somos una empresa joven, con perspectivas de crecimiento rápido y en la actualidad contamos con oficinas en Vitoria, Santander, Barcelona, Hamburgo y Ulm (Alemania)

¿Qué buscamos?

En LIS Data Solutions queremos incorporar DEVELOPERS MID/SENIOR con especialización en lenguajes de backend Java y Python para ayudar en el desarrollo de nuestras soluciones en nuestras oficinas de Bezana (Cantabria).

Descripción de funciones:
• Trabajar junto al resto de componentes del equipo de desarrollo para diseñar y desarrollar nuestras soluciones.
•... Desarrollar aplicaciones en Python y Java, con interacción con sistemas de BBDD, asegurando su escalabilidad y rendimiento.
• Trabajar con herramientas de control de versiones como Git.
• Colaborar en el desarrollo de una arquitectura de software basada en Docker y Kubernetes.
• Participar en el diseño y desarrollo de APIs para integrar diferentes servicios y aplicaciones.
• Participar en la revisión del código y asegurar que los estándares de calidad sean cumplidos.

Requisitos deseables:
• 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software backend, concretamente en Python y Java.
• Conocimiento en la utilización de Docker y Kubernetes en la construcción de aplicaciones de software.
• Manejo con entornos de Bases de Datos, tanto SQL (Postgres, MySQL, SQLServer) como No SQL (Mongo DB).
• Familiaridad con Git u otros sistemas de control de versiones.
• Experiencia en el diseño y desarrollo de APIs para la integración de diferentes servicios y aplicaciones.
• Habilidades de resolución de problemas y depuración de software.
• Excelentes capacidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar en equipo y cliente.
• Inglés mínimo B2

Ofrecemos:
• Un entorno de desarrollo profesional dinámico y gratificante, con posibilidades reales de progreso
• Flexibilidad horaria
• Estabilidad laboral
• Entrada inmediata
• Contrato indefinido a jornada completa
• Gimnasio gratis
• Salario: Según valía y/o experiencia

jobs_results.description:
About Fundcraft

fundcraft is a fast-growing, tech-powered fund services provider, aiming to revolutionise the fund management industry through our proprietary platform. Our dedicated team of financial experts, lawyers, tech developers, and data scientists are fully committed to turning the organisation to a leading fund services firm, in Europe and beyond. The company was founded in 2020 and has been experiencing rapid growth, already employing more than 75 professionals in two countries.

About The Role

Key responsibilities:
• You will collaborate with a cross-functional scrum team that develops in Python, ReactJS, Docker and AWS Cloud technologies
• You will design, build and maintain API’s, services and systems across fundcraft’s engineering teams
• You will collaborate in improving engineering standards, tooling and processes

How you will be successful in your application

Must-Have Experience / Qualifications
• You have at least 1 year of experience working as a Backend... Engineer
• Experience in the development, deployment, and maintenance of web-based technology applications with Python or the ability and interest in working with it
• Devotion to clean and well-done code
• Spanish: fluent level (spoken and written)
• English: fluent level (spoken and written)

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with other elements of fundcraft's tech stack: Django, Celery, OpenAPI, Javascript, React, PostgreSQL, AWS
• Experience working with Agile methodologies

What you will get in return

A culture where you can thrive..
• An entrepreneurial culture encouraging creativity and innovative, disruptive ideas,
• A diverse and fast-paced work environment and the ability to interact with/learn from a wide variety of specialists,
• A multicultural team promoting our corporate values of Ownership, Transparency, Team spirit, Boldness,
• Workplace automation and application of new technologies across workflows.

Benefits To Support You In Your Journey..
• Internal training and career development opportunities,
• Stock options offerings - our success is your success,
• Flexible working hours, home working options, attractive package after 1 year,
• Ergonomic work equipment and spacious, modern offices located in Girona(We are 5 min walk from the train station)

Selection process
• Stage 1: Video interview with our HR department (45 min)
• Stage 2: Meet the Team: interview with the hiring manager and a senior member of the team (45 min)
• Stage 3: Interview with a member of the management team or another member of the team (Optional) (45 min

Requirements:
• Technical degree preferred.
• Development projects techniques and skills; mainly phyton, kubernetes, mongodb, redis.
• Proven knowledge to create application in cloud
• Knowledge of google cloud platform
• Knowledge of app mobile industry
• Have residence in Spain

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
¡Hola! ¿Ya nos hemos presentado? Somos Eurofirms Group, una empresa de Recursos Humanos en la que los humanos somos muchísimo más que recursos. Somos la 1ª empresa nacional del sector y llevamos más de 30 años trabajando con un mismo propósito: mejorar la vida de las personas creando un entorno en el que poder brillar.

En Eurofirms Group creemos en el talento único de cada persona y sabemos que la diversidad aporta valor a los equipos, impulsando organizaciones más innovadoras, creativas y eficientes. Por eso, de acuerdo con nuestra cultura People first, trabajamos para generar entornos laborales inclusivos en los que cada individuo pueda crecer y desarrollar su mejor versión. Asimismo, buscamos actuar como agentes de cambio para promover la igualdad de oportunidades en nuestro entorno, fomentando el respeto y apostando por la diversidad en todas sus formas.

Seas como seas y sientas como sientas, en Eurofirms Group tendrás un sitio para brillar.

¿Deseas unirte a una empresa que... crece y evoluciona constantemente?

En Eurofirms seleccionamos a Backend Developer para formar parte del área IT en nuestros Servicios Corporativos en Cassà de la Selva o en nuestra oficina de L'Hospitalet de Llobregat.

¿Qué harás?

Serás el/la responsable del desarrollo del backend de los aplicativos de la empresa.

Entre tus funciones, te ocuparás de las siguientes tareas:
• Implementar código limpio, reutilizable y escalable.
• Revisar, depurar, actualizar y refactorizar código.
• Integrar componentes de software y servicios de 3eros.
• Testear y desplegar versiones en diferentes entornos.
• Participar en el análisis de los requerimientos.
• Colaborar con el equipo interno para desarrollar la arquitectura necesaria.
• Documentación del ciclo de desarrollo (SDLC).

¿Qué esperamos de ti?

Buscamos una persona detallista, resolutiva, meticulosa, organizada y proactiva con espíritu de mejora. Que sea detallista y resolutiva, con habilidad para aprender nuevos lenguajes y tecnologías y tenga capacidad para trabajar en equipo.

Requisitos:
• Experiencia en POO (programación orientada a objetos) con C# y .NET.
• Experiencia en integración de datos utilizando servicios web.
• Experiencia con base de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSql).
• Conocimientos de lenguaje de programación C# y framework .NET
• Conocimientos de lenguaje de base de datos SQL.
• Conocimientos de entornos de desarrollo como Visual Studio o Visual Code.
• Familiarizado con arquitecturas de servicios APIs (REST/SOAP).
• Conocimientos de sistemas de control de versión (Git).
• Conocimientos de pruebas unitatias y TDD
• Metodología de trabajo Agile.

Se valorará:
• Deseable experiencia con bases de datos no-relacionales (Elasticsearch, Redis).
• Deseable experiencia aplicando principios de arquitecturas limpias (SOLID).
• Deseable experiencia en testeo unitario y funcional de código.
• Deseable experiencia en sistemas de eventos (RabbitMq).

¿Qué ventajas tiene trabajar en una empresa People first?

En Eurofirms Group te ofrecemos el mejor entorno y condiciones para que puedas brillar tanto en tu vida profesional como en la personal.

Un trabajo que hace de la conciliación una realidad:
• Un día de teletrabajo a la semana.
• Tarde libre semanal.
• Retribución flexible para ahorrar en tus gastos de manutención, transporte, guardería o seguro médico a través de Cobee.

Tu salud, y la de los tuyos, es lo primero:
• Mutua de salud gratuita y con descuentos para tu familia, a partir de los 2 años en Eurofirms
• Descuento del 50% en la cuota de múltiples gimnasios disponibles en la app AndJoy.

A tu lado en los momentos especiales:
• Día libre el día de tu cumpleaños.

Si te apasiona el mundo de la innovación y la tecnología, esta es tu oportunidad para crecer en la primera empresa nacional de recursos humanos. ¡Únete a nuestro equipo EurofirmsIT
